name: Father Vermond
source:
"I serve God, I do everything according to God's will. I say that but, it really is hard you know?"

Born in France.
Hobby: Nothing in Particular
Likes: Taking Walks
Dislikes: Nothing in Particular

A French priest, he's one of [url=/c50768]Marie Antoinette's[/url] tutors.
A kind person who never gets angry.
He's always being taken advantage of by the protagonist, Marie, and [url=/c50774]Count Mercy[/url].
But he's always willing to give advice when the protagonist is worrying.
